On the XBT Lightning screen, tap Funding, Cross-chain payments, then Transactions. Each open tab should widen, turn white, and show its full name. The other two should become compact green and blue icon buttons. Try larger iPhone text as well.

When the connection wheel appears, its center should line up vertically with the balance. Tapping the balance should still change the display unit.

Open a previously saved cross-chain payment in history and scroll to the bottom. The rounded Cancel / Close button should be easy to see and tap. Closing pending payment details should leave the payment tracked. These checks can use existing history and do not require making a payment.
